source_caption_text:
#Blueface & His BM Nevaeh Spotted Courtside At The Lakers Game 😳👀

Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Michael Porter, is a 29-year-old American rapper, entertainer, and livestreamer from Los Angeles, California. Born on January 20, 1997, Blueface rose to fame in 2018 after his unique offbeat rapping style and viral personality caught the attention of millions across social media.

He became a household name with his breakout hit “Thotiana,” which peaked at No. 8 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 2019. The song received popular remixes featuring Cardi B and YG, helping establish Blueface as one of the most recognizable faces in West Coast hip-hop. Other notable songs include “Respect My Cryppin,” “Bleed It,” and “Dead Locs.” He was also selected for the 2019 XXL Freshman Class. 

Before pursuing music, Blueface was a talented football player who played quarterback at Arleta High School and briefly attended Fayetteville State University. However, he eventually shifted his focus to music and built a successful entertainment career.
